get.description: Retrieve a list of articles from the knowledge base. This endpoint allows filtering and sorting articles based on creation and update timestamps, state, language, and other attributes. It supports pagination and can include additional details such as the article body and translations.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A pagination cursor. Pass the value from the previous response’s paging.next.after to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: archivedInDashboard
parameters.description: Filter articles based on whether they are archived in the dashboard.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Filter to articles belonging to the specified category ID(s). Accepts multiple values, repeated as separate query parameters.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Filter to articles created after the specified date-time. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (e.g., 2026-09-20).

parameters.name: createdAt
parameters.description: Filter articles to those with this exact creation timestamp. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (e.g., 2026-09-20).

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Filter to articles created before the specified date-time. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (e.g., 2026-09-20).

parameters.name: includeBody
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include each article’s HTML content (the body field) in the response. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: includeTranslations
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include a summary of each article’s translations (id, title, and state per language) in the response. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: knowledgeBaseId
parameters.description: Filter to articles belonging to the specified knowledge base ID(s). Accepts multiple values, repeated as separate query parameters.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Filter articles by a specific language. Accepts an ISO 639 language code (e.g., en, es), optionally with a region subtag (e.g., en-US). Accepts multiple values, repeated as separate query parameters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of results to display per page. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Specify how to sort results. Accepts name, createdAt, or updatedAt; prefix a field with - for descending order (e.g., -createdAt). Defaults to createdAt descending (newest first).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter to articles in the specified state. Accepted values are DRAFT or PUBLISHED.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Filter to articles updated after the specified date-time. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (e.g., 2026-09-20).

parameters.name: updatedAt
parameters.description: Filter articles to those with this exact update timestamp. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (e.g., 2026-09-20).

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Filter to articles updated before the specified date-time. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (e.g., 2026-09-20).

post.description: Creates a new article under the specified knowledge base and language in a draft state. Requires knowledgeBaseId, title, and language; optionally accepts subtitle, body, categoryId, path, metaDescription, tagIds, accessType, accessGroupIds, and translationOfId (to link this article as a translation of an existing one). Returns the created article, including its assigned ID and public URL.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve a specific article from the knowledge base using its unique identifier.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the article to retrieve.

parameters.name: includeBody
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the article’s HTML content (the body field) in the response. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: includeTranslations
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include a summary of the article’s translations (id, title, and state per language) in the response. Defaults to true.

patch.description:
Update an existing article using its unique identifier. Only the fields included in the request are modified — omitted fields are left unchanged. Supports updating title, subtitle, body, category, tags, access settings, and metadata.

ArchivedInDashboard is a CMS-specific property that controls the article’s visibility in the dashboard UI and has no other effect on the article’s state.

To delete an article, set archived to true and include no other fields in the request body. This endpoint does not support restoring an archived article — setting archived to false will fail.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the article to update.

get.description: Retrieve the draft version of a specific article in the knowledge base. This endpoint allows you to access the draft content of an article, which can be useful for reviewing or editing purposes before publishing.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the article whose draft version is being retrieved.

parameters.name: includeBody
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the article’s HTML content (the body field) in the response. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: includeTranslations
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include a summary of the article’s translations (id, title, and state per language) in the response. Defaults to true.

patch.description: Update the draft version of a specific knowledge base article. This endpoint allows you to modify the draft content of an article, including its title, body, and other properties. Use this endpoint to stage changes to an article before it is published live.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the article whose draft is to be updated.

post.description: Push a draft version of a knowledge base article live. This operation is useful when you want to make the latest changes to an article available to the public. Ensure that the draft is finalized before performing this action.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the article whose draft version is to be published.

post.description: Unpublish a specific article in the knowledge base by its ID.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the article to unpublish.
